hunter_heuristic.summary: Each day: list_documents, check_leak_feed. suspects = all employees; for each leaked feed item intersect suspects with the canary variant group (if the doc is a canary and the item has a variant) else with the doc recipients. If one suspect left or day >= deadline, accuse (the single suspect, else a random remaining one). Else plant canary 1: shuffle suspects, first half variant A, rest B. If canaries_per_day>=2 and >=4 suspects, plant canary 2 alternating A/B over the same order. Then advance_day.

hunter_solver_idea.summary: Posterior over suspects from public evidence only: days a leak happened (V drop), surfaced feed items with variant, who held each doc. Per suspect s and closed day d: no leak -> (1-p_leak) if s had a leakable doc else 1; leak -> p_leak times weight of the surfaced doc among s's leakable docs times P(delay). Accuse when P(correct)*V + (1-P(correct))*(-1) > 0 and the posterior is high.

mole_rules_for_be_the_mole.mechanics: mole may leak a doc it received in days d-2..d not yet leaked, gated by p_leak 0.65 per day; leak surfaces in feed after 2 or 3 days; if the doc is a canary the feed shows the mole's variant with prob 0.95 else another variant; careful_mole: canary leak probability scaled by (1 - share of staff holding it); framing: Poisson(2.0)/day fake after-hours accesses attributed to others, half to the decoy; each leak costs V 0.05
